search.summary: Bounded depth-first search of the tree with text/kind/feature/operation filters.

depth.description: Search depth; negative -> 0, capped at 64. Ignored when the maxDepth key is present.

query.description: Case-insensitive substring matched against ord, slotPath, name, display, description, typeSpec.

cov.summary: Point value changes for subscribed points (direct or group), batched when covBatchWindowMillis > 0; points holds snapshots or per-point error entries.

alarm_cov.summary: Alarm event per matching alarm subscription. inScope when a record is present; refreshRecommended (event null) when not; alarms when mode is snapshot/both or no record.

model_cov.summary: Model change hint. Component events carry eventId/event/slot/source (+valueType/value when not sensitive); after a model plan applies, event='model_plan_applied' with affected bases.

subscriptions_revoked.summary: Revalidation dropped subscriptions the user can no longer see: points (read permission or path policy; also points that failed to resolve on two consecutive sweeps), alarm subscription filters now outside the path policy, and model subscriptions whose component is gone or no longer readable. reason is 'authorization_revoked'.

session_revoked.summary: Sent before the server closes the socket (1008) because the user left the station.

error.summary: Error frame. Reply to any failed request (id echoed when given); also sent unsolicited (no id) when an alarm subscription fails its policy check during alarm event delivery.

resync_required.summary: The session's event backlog overflowed and queued events were dropped; re-read what the client shows (read, read_alarms, browse). COV resumes normally.

request_timeout.summary: A request ran longer than 10 minutes; the server closes the session (close code 1011) right after this notice.

alarm_failed.meaning: AlarmService unavailable or alarm database/read failure; also a per-uuid entry for unexpected ack/clear failures.

auth_required.meaning: No authenticated Niagara user at the WebSocket handshake; the socket is closed (1008), no frame is sent.

bad_reference.meaning: Model @ref does not identify an earlier create/clone, or a ref is duplicated.

bad_request.meaning: Malformed request or field (type, range, missing field, MessagePack decoding); also per-item in write/tag results.

browse_failed.meaning: Unexpected failure resolving a browse/describe target.

children_present.meaning: Deleting a component with children requires recursive=true.

confirm_required.meaning: The model plan invokes an action Niagara marks confirm-required; resend the change with confirm: true.

cycle.meaning: Cannot move a component into its own subtree.

forbidden_action.meaning: User cannot invoke the write action slot on the point; also request-level for model invoke without invoke+admin-write.

forbidden_alarm.meaning: Missing operator write (ack) or admin write (force-clear) on the alarm class.

forbidden_component.meaning: Model target outside allowedPathPatterns, unreadable, or lacking admin write.

forbidden_point.meaning: Target outside allowedPathPatterns or not readable/invokable/admin-writable; also per-item in read/subscribe/write/tag/alarm results.

frozen_slot.meaning: Only dynamic child components/properties can be moved, renamed, deleted or removed.

history_failed.meaning: History lookup/query failed or the point has no readable history extensions.

idempotency_conflict.meaning: Plan already submitted with another key, or the key belongs to another plan.

illegal_parent.meaning: Niagara rejected this parent/child type combination.

implied_tag.meaning: Tag is implied by a tag dictionary and cannot be removed.

internal_error.meaning: Unhandled server exception while processing the request.

invalid_action.meaning: Model invoke names an action slot that does not exist.

invalid_alarm.meaning: Alarm record not found or not readable.

invalid_component.meaning: Model ORD does not resolve to a component/struct, or configure_hierarchy target is not hierarchy:Hierarchy.

invalid_link.meaning: Niagara link check failed, or delete_link slot does not hold a link.

invalid_name.meaning: Not a valid Niagara slot name (1-128 chars).

invalid_point.meaning: Blank/unsupported ORD scheme, unresolvable target or wrong target kind; also per-item in read/subscribe/write/tag results.

invalid_property.meaning: Property path does not exist, crosses a scalar, is empty, or addresses a link/relation.

invalid_type.meaning: Unknown, abstract, incompatible, link/relation or unrepresentable type for a model value/component.

invalid_value.meaning: Encoded value was not understood by the type's decoder (would be stored as null).

model_busy.meaning: Another model plan is currently applying.

model_change_failed.meaning: Non-protocol exception during a model apply step; outcome unknown_or_partial.

model_edits_disabled.meaning: modelEditsEnabled is false on the service; also a step result if flipped mid-apply.

model_limit.meaning: Model size bounds exceeded (slots, branch, snapshot, nesting, preview size, dependencies).

name_conflict.meaning: Slot name already exists (collision=fail) or no suffix could be allocated.

not_writable.meaning: Target is not a Niagara writable point or its type is unsupported.

plan_closed.meaning: Plan is not in preview state (cannot apply or cancel).

plan_conflict.meaning: Overlapping property or structural edits in one plan; use separate previews.

plan_dependency.meaning: Change depends on a branch moved/renamed/deleted/created earlier in the same plan.

plan_mismatch.meaning: planHash does not match the stored plan.

plan_not_found.meaning: Plan unknown, expired, or owned by another user.

protected_component.meaning: The baskStream service and its descendants cannot be edited remotely.

read_failed.meaning: Point snapshot could not be produced or the target is no longer available.

relation_not_found.meaning: No matching direct relation to remove.

response_too_large.meaning: The reply would exceed the 8 MiB outbound limit; request less (smaller depth, limit, time range or field list). The session stays open.

search_failed.meaning: Unexpected failure resolving the search root.

stale_plan.meaning: Principal, target, property, slot or branch changed since preview; also a per-step apply result.

subscription_limit.meaning: maxSubscriptionsPerClient or group limit reached; per-point entry in subscribe/replace_subscriptions.

tag_not_found.meaning: No direct tag with this id to remove.

unsupported_action.meaning: Write action unsupported by the point; also request-level for an unknown model action.

unsupported_op.meaning: Operation name is not in the protocol.

write_cancelled.meaning: Session closed or thread interrupted before the write invocation.

write_failed.meaning: Unexpected runtime failure writing a point, or enum point without an enum range.

writes_disabled.meaning: Service disabled or writesEnabled is false; also per-item if flipped mid-batch.
